source_name: OTP banka Slovenija / Nova KBM – shared ATM network announcements
why_relevant: ATM-pooling and post-merger network consolidation (NKBM+Abanka, then NKBM+SKB under OTP) directly drive ATM hardware, cash-handling and managed-service procurement. Bank press pages date these consolidation events and give network sizes (492, ~450 ATMs) used to scope deals.

source_name: Bank general terms & conditions PDFs (splošni pogoji) – card and payment services
why_relevant: Issuer T&Cs name the schemes, processors and card products in force at each bank and are re-issued when a processing or scheme arrangement changes — a dated, verifiable indirect signal of vendor/scheme switches that are never announced.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja (e-money institutions register)
why_relevant: Statutory register under ZPlaSSIED of licensed e-money issuers, their agents and branches, plus incoming EEA passport notifications. Identifies non-bank issuers who procure card/wallet/processing technology.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev in infrastruktur finančnega trga
why_relevant: Hub page from which the payment-institution, PISP/AISP and payment-system-operator lists hang; also names supervised FMI operators (e.g. payment system operators) that run large procurement.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Plačilne institucije držav EGP v Sloveniji (EEA payment institutions passporting into SI)
why_relevant: Lists foreign EEA payment institutions active in Slovenia — competitors/partners not visible in the domestic licence list, and potential bidders in bank-side sourcing.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register kreditnih posrednikov / ponudnikov finančnega zakupa / serviserjev kreditov
why_relevant: Adjacent statutory registers (credit intermediaries, real-estate leasing providers, NPL credit servicers) discovered on the supervised-entities page; these firms buy collection, onboarding and KYC technology.
Authoritative membership list of the Bank Association of Slovenia — member banks, savings banks and leasing companies. Directly enumerates the Slovenian bank buyer universe for tenders and RFPs.

source_name: ZBS – Organiziranost / committees and working bodies
why_relevant: Committee and working-group structure names the bank staff who own payments, cards, IT security and compliance agendas — the people who define requirements before a tender is published.
Association-published banking journal; articles reveal projects, vendors and modernisation programmes months before procurement, and identify subject-matter owners inside member banks.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nacionalni svet za plačila (National Payments Council), membership and session minutes
why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder council whose membership list enumerates the umbrella organisations of the Slovenian payment market (central bank, Bankart, ZBS, GZS, ministries, AML office). Published minutes name the institutions and the initiatives that later become procurement.

source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT), Članstvo
why_relevant: The chamber's ICT association — the supply side. Its membership/board pages enumerate the Slovenian IT vendors and integrators most likely to bid on bank and public-sector payment tenders.

source_name: GZS – Zbornica / sectoral association directory (26 sectoral associations)
why_relevant: Umbrella chamber index: from here the finance-adjacent and ICT sectoral associations (and their member directories) can be enumerated, giving a broad supplier-side actor map beyond ZIT.

source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija – digitalna.si (working groups and partners)
why_relevant: GZS-coordinated multi-stakeholder digitalisation coalition; its working-group (delovne skupine) and project pages name participating companies and public bodies, including the blockchain/fintech cluster, i.e. a cross-sector actor index.
Slovenian-registered blockchain/crypto industry association; membership overlaps heavily with the domestic fintech/crypto-payments vendor pool.

source_name: SBCA – Slovenian Blockchain Association / Slovensko blockchain združenje
why_relevant: Second Slovenian blockchain/crypto association; useful for completing the crypto-payments actor universe and for cross-referencing with Blockchain Alliance membership.

source_name: OPSI – Informativni seznam naročnikov po Zakonu o javnem naročanju (official list of contracting authorities)
why_relevant: The statutory index of every entity that must procure under ZJN-3 — the definitive buyer list for the A2 tender workstream, obtained as structured open data rather than scraped notice by notice.

source_name: ATVP – Registri (securities market registers: investment firms, tied agents, public companies)
why_relevant: Securities-market regulator's statutory registers complete the financial-sector actor universe beyond banking/payments (brokerages, fund managers, listed issuers), all of which run IT and compliance procurement.

source_name: EBA central register of payment and e-money institutions under PSD2 (filterable to SI)
why_relevant: EU-level mirror of the national payment/e-money registers, downloadable in bulk — a cross-check on the Banka Slovenije lists and a way to catch inbound passporting firms. Note it excludes credit institutions by design.
